result.reason: The operative addition fully satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the lower fallback limits. It appropriately applies the coverages throughout the Term and directs certificates to Customer upon request. It is not strictly minimal because the rendered clause unnecessarily reverses the order of the pre-existing clauses (i) and (iii), although their text and commercial effect remain intact.
